_readme: One entry per service page. 'description' should be aligned with the copy actually published on that page before you ship the markup: structured data must describe what the page says. 'price' is optional; leave empty and no Offer is emitted.

services.name: Existing Building Inspection
services.description: Independent inspection of an established residential or commercial building, reporting on structural condition, defects, moisture and safety hazards so owners and buyers know the true condition of the property.
services.serviceOutput: Written building condition report covering defects, structural condition and recommended rectification.
services.audience: Property owners, buyers and investors of established buildings
items: Roof covering and roof space inspection

services.name: Renovation and Extension Inspection
services.description: Staged inspections across renovation and extension projects, checking workmanship and compliance with the approved plans, the National Construction Code and relevant Australian Standards before each progress payment is released.
services.serviceOutput: Stage-by-stage inspection reports supporting progress claims and final handover.
services.audience: Homeowners and investors renovating or extending a property
items: Structural alteration and support beam inspection

services.name: New Building Inspection
services.description: Independent construction stage inspections for new homes and buildings, from footings through to handover, verifying that completed work matches the approved plans, the National Construction Code and relevant Australian Standards.
services.serviceOutput: Stage inspection reports and a practical completion defect list for the builder to rectify.
services.audience: Owners building a new home or building
items: Base, slab and footing stage inspection

services.name: Adjoining Works Protection and Dilapidation Reporting
services.serviceType: Dilapidation and adjoining property protection inspection
services.description: Protection of adjoining property inspections and dilapidation reports that record and photograph the condition of neighbouring buildings before, during and after excavation, demolition or construction works, so any damage claim can be settled on documented evidence.
services.serviceOutput: Photographic dilapidation report recording the pre-existing and post-works condition of adjoining property.
services.audience: Builders, developers, owners and neighbouring property owners
items: Excavation, piling and shoring impact assessment
Party wall and boundary structure inspection

services.name: Pre-Purchase Building Inspection
services.description: Pre-purchase standard property inspection carried out in line with AS 4349.1, identifying major and minor defects, structural movement, safety hazards and signs of unapproved work before you commit to buying.
services.serviceOutput: Standard property inspection report to AS 4349.1, delivered in writing before exchange.
items: Roof, ceiling and roof void inspection
Moisture testing to bathrooms and wet areas

services.name: Strata Inspection Report
services.description: Strata inspection report for buyers of a unit, apartment or townhouse, reviewing the owners corporation books and records alongside the condition of common property so you understand the building's finances, defects and disputes before exchange.
services.serviceOutput: Strata inspection report summarising records, levies, capital works funding, defects and disputes.
services.audience: Buyers of strata titled units, apartments and townhouses
items: Owners corporation books and records inspection
Levies, arrears and special levy review
Meeting minutes, by-laws and dispute review

services.name: Building Insurance Assessment
services.description: Independent assessment of building damage for insurance purposes, documenting the cause and extent of the damage and the scope of works required to reinstate the building, so a claim can be lodged or disputed on technical evidence.
services.serviceOutput: Independent damage assessment report with cause of damage findings and a scope of reinstatement works.
services.audience: Property owners, landlords and strata managers making an insurance claim

services.name: Building Warranty and Defect Inspection
services.serviceType: Building defect and statutory warranty inspection
services.description: Defect inspections and reports for owners within the statutory warranty period, documenting defective and incomplete building work with the evidence needed to have the builder rectify it or to support a warranty claim.
services.serviceOutput: Itemised defect report and rectification schedule for builder or warranty claim use.
services.audience: Home owners, owners corporations and investors inside the statutory warranty period

services.name: Building and Pest Inspection
services.description: Combined building and timber pest inspection carried out in line with AS 4349.1 and AS 4349.3, covering building defects together with termite activity, timber pest damage and the conditions conducive to attack, in one written report.
services.serviceOutput: Combined building and timber pest report to AS 4349.1 and AS 4349.3.

services.name: Commercial Building Inspection
services.description: Inspections of commercial, industrial and retail property covering building condition, defects and the building fabric, for purchasers, tenants, landlords and asset owners making acquisition, leasing or maintenance decisions.
services.serviceOutput: Commercial building condition and defect report.
services.audience: Commercial purchasers, tenants, landlords and asset managers
items: Roof, facade and external envelope inspection
Maintenance and capital expenditure planning input

services.name: Pre-Auction Building Inspection
services.description: Fast turnaround building inspection before auction day, so you can bid knowing the property's defects and repair exposure. Auction purchases are unconditional, which makes inspecting beforehand the only opportunity to find problems.
services.serviceOutput: Pre-auction inspection report delivered ahead of auction day.
